consent.ai.body: Winkly's planning suggestions are generated by AI. To make them, a small, limited set of your profile details (like age, city, interests and dietary preferences — never your name, contacts or messages) is sent to our AI providers. Suggestions can be imperfect — always use your own judgement, especially for safety.
consent.ai.title: AI suggestions
consent.collect.body: The profile details you choose to enter (such as your name, age, city, photos, interests and lifestyle), the messages you send, and a coarse, approximate location you can turn on for discovery. Your exact location is never stored — only a rounded area — and your date of birth is never shown to other people, only your age.
consent.collect.title: What we collect
consent.fineprint: You need to agree to use Winkly. If you don't, you can close the app.
consent.lead: Winkly needs a few details about you to help you meet people and plan things to do. Here's how your data is used. Please read this and agree before you add any personal information.
consent.rights.body: You can view, export or permanently delete your data at any time in Settings. For the full details, see our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
consent.rights.title: Your rights
consent.saveFailed: Couldn't save your choice. Please check your connection and try again.
consent.sensitive.body: Some fields are optional and more sensitive — for example religion. If you choose to fill these in, you explicitly agree to Winkly storing and showing them on your profile to help with matching. You can leave them blank, change them, or delete them at any time, and doing so withdraws your consent for that field.
